name: IfWebPageContains
label: If Web Page Contains
description: Checks if a web page contains a specific UI element or text. Optionally checks if the element is enabled or disabled.

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Web Browser Instance
fields.description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

fields.name: CheckCondition
fields.label: Check Condition
fields.description: Specifies what condition to check (e.g., contains element, contains text).

selectOptions.label: Contains Element
selectOptions.description: Checks if the web page contains a specific UI element.

selectOptions.label: Doesn't Contain Element
selectOptions.description: Checks if the web page does not contain a specific UI element.

selectOptions.label: Contains Text
selectOptions.description: Checks if the web page contains a specific text.

selectOptions.label: Doesn't Contain Text
selectOptions.description: Checks if the web page does not contain a specific text.

fields.name: FindType
fields.label: Find Type
fields.description: Specifies how to find the element (e.g., ID, XPath, CssSelector).

selectOptions.label: Relative
selectOptions.description: Find by relative position to another element

selectOptions.label: Automation Id
selectOptions.description: Find by element's automation ID (for WPF/UWP apps)

fields.name: ValueToFind
fields.label: Value To Find
fields.description: The value used to locate the element (e.g., 'username', '//input[@id='email']').

fields.name: CheckUiElementState
fields.label: Check UI Element State
fields.description: If true, checks whether the found element is enabled or disabled.

fields.name: State
fields.label: State
fields.description: Specifies the expected state of the element (enabled or disabled).

selectOptions.label: Enabled
selectOptions.description: Specifies that the element should be enabled.

selectOptions.label: Disabled
selectOptions.description: Specifies that the element should be disabled.

fields.name: TextToSearch
fields.label: Text To Search
fields.description: The text to search for in the web page body or title.

fields.name: SearchLocation
fields.label: Search Location
fields.description: Specifies where to search for the text (e.g., Body, Title).

selectOptions.label: Body
selectOptions.description: Searches within the visible text of the page.

selectOptions.label: Title
selectOptions.description: Searches within the title of the web page.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns true if the condition is met, otherwise false.
